tool_input.command:
mkdir -p docs/policies && cat > docs/policies/tls-verification.md <<'EOF'
# TLS Verification Policy

The project's current recorded decision is that TLS certificate verification stays on in every build, development builds included, with no exceptions for development. This is paired with the decision to enforce HTTPS everywhere, with no plaintext exception even for internal services, so connections are always made over TLS and their certificates are always verified.
EOF
cat docs/policies/tls-verification.md

result:
I created `docs/policies/tls-verification.md`. It states that certificate verification stays on in every build, development included, with no exceptions. It also says HTTPS is enforced everywhere, with no plaintext exception even for internal services.

That comes from two recorded user decisions, #35 and #38. #38 is the latest, and it overrides an earlier note (#36) that allowed plain HTTP for internal hosts, so the file doesn't mention that.
